# Transfer Client Manual

> An independent manual in plain English for WinSCP 6.7.1: what the free client does, how to install it and connect, what it costs, and how it compares with other clients.

Independent guides to WinSCP by Transfer Client Manual. Facts come from the vendor's pages on the date shown on each page.

## Start
- [WinSCP download: get version 6.7.1 from the official site](https://winscp-app.github.io/download.html): Download WinSCP 6.7.1 from the official site: 13 MB free installer, Windows 7 to 11, what is new in 6.7, portable option and five install steps.

## Decide
- [WinSCP review: a free Windows SFTP client with real automation](https://winscp-app.github.io/review.html): WinSCP 6.7.1 reviewed from its documentation: interfaces, SFTP, FTP, WebDAV and S3 support, scripting, pros and cons, and who should pick another client.
- [Is WinSCP free? Licence, Microsoft Store price and donations](https://winscp-app.github.io/is-it-free.html): WinSCP is free and open source, including for business use. What the $19.99 Microsoft Store copy is, donation options, and which terms are not published.

## Do it
- [How to use WinSCP: connect to an SFTP server and upload files](https://winscp-app.github.io/connect-sftp.html): How to use WinSCP step by step: New Site in the Login dialog, protocol, host and port, saving the site, checking the host key, and uploading with F5 or drag.
- [WinSCP errors: fixes for connection, host key and transfer problems](https://winscp-app.github.io/errors.html): Fix common WinSCP errors: cannot connect, host key warnings, Received too large SFTP packet, error code 4, Error 127, and scripts failing in Task Scheduler.

## Compare
- [WinSCP vs FileZilla: which free file transfer client to choose](https://winscp-app.github.io/winscp-vs-filezilla.html): WinSCP vs FileZilla: platforms, SFTP, SCP, WebDAV and S3 support, scripting, editor and price, with a clear rule for which client fits which user.
- [WinSCP alternatives for Mac, Linux and Windows](https://winscp-app.github.io/alternatives.html): Seven WinSCP alternatives: FileZilla, Cyberduck, MobaXterm, Bitvise, PuTTY, rclone and OpenSSH, with platforms, cost and when each one is the better pick.

## Full text
- [llms-full.txt](https://winscp-app.github.io/llms-full.txt): every guide on this site in plain markdown
